ns2:section.sectionText: *Eligible for the PR Minor: https://media.illinois.edu/pr_minor. Students who have completed ADV 290 INF Becoming an Influencer (FA 75264; SP 71950) or MACS 295 INF (SP 69211) should not register for ADV 301. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Meets with MACS 295 INF (69211). If seats are full in ADV 301, please check for availability in MACS 295.
